summary: This is a Hong Kong Stock Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return filed as a 6-K by Kanzhun Ltd. The filing details a routine share buyback program and modest equity issuance via option exercises. It reports 4,000 new shares issued at $5.33 per share on June 24, 2026, and 17 tranches of shares repurchased for cancellation between May 27 and June 23, 2026, at prices ranging from approximately $6.67 to $7.25 per share. Board recommendation is not specified; no advisor is named. Mechanically, the buybacks reduce the outstanding share count and may boost EPS. The filing is a standard capital allocation update — the buyback program appears continuous, with no special tender or high premium. Watch for potential acceleration or completion of the repurchase plan.
